A commitment has one accountable lead plus zero or more contributors. Only the lead consumes the non-transferable register slot; approved Work and exact-CID-de-duplicated evidence preserve contributor attribution only while Accepted and unfrozen, but evidence contributes at most one recognition participation credit per contributor while later CIDs remain provenance. Late approvals are observed but non-counting, and uncounted linked Work blocks contributor exit until Accepted-and-unfrozen steward unlink or the first countable approval. Recognition eligibility additionally requires the commitment to be Fulfilled, the roster and credit ledger freeze atomically on every transition to ReadyForConfirmation and on a direct Disputed-to-Fulfilled resolution, and every team member is excluded from confirmation. Garden claims reject both a creator claimant and a creator requestedBy requester, including the ApprovalGated acceptance recheck.

The Hypercert gardener class allocates equal budgets to fulfilled commitments, then applies the immutable cycle-open RecognitionPolicy through independent exact equal-participation and verified-contribution remainder passes before adding the row results. The protocol default and cycle-less preset are 20/80, not a fixed cycle invariant. Stable recognition bps remain commitment-scoped, while integer units are persisted per Hypercert + commitment + contributor so repeated bundling cannot overwrite a previous certificate. There is no automatic lead or metadata-only fallback: Ready and direct Fulfilled dispute resolution require an available policy plus pre-freeze totalVerifiedCredits > 0, and W26 blocks inconsistent legacy/indexed zero-eligible state. Each cycle tracks liveCommitmentCount in O(1), and closeCycle/cancelCycle require zero so recognition cannot change after a terminal cycle transition.

G$ commitment support is accounted to the provider garden, whose Celo Safe pays contributors through one stable CommitmentPayoutPlan. Creation binds the complete recognition vector to its hash and uses deterministic full-reward base-unit apportionment; a normalized bps difference caused only by that canonical rounding is not a steward divergence. Atomic noncanonical amount or retention edits derive payment weights and require a reason. The provider account must remain Active for edit, finalization, first preparation, ContributorReward batching, and initial dispatch. Explicit finalization verifies retained-plus-payout conservation, freezes the plan, and creates no child. Idempotent per-contributor preparation later materializes one immutable Queued child from a frozen non-zero row. Protocol Safe to garden Safe value is Funding/ProtocolToGarden queued only through queueFunding, never a garden-beneficiary commitment reward; CCIP transports data only, and authenticated acknowledgment remains the sole path to Confirmed.
